_text: [dramatic, booming] Then, on Valentine's weekend... it's *showtime*. [urgent, building] Layer one, the heat sensor. You see, your hairspray coated its lens, like breath on cold glasses. It's *blind*. [playful] Layer two: The Genius shuffles past the beam behind a foam board, like a kid behind a pizza *box*. [amused] Layer three, the light sensor. Beaten by... *tape*. [urgent, building] Layer four, the magnets: an aluminium plate taped on, so the alarm thinks the door never opened. [dramatic, alarmed] And the hundred million lock? It just... opens. Nobody knows how, even today. [excited] Inside: one-hundred-and-eighty-nine boxes. By sunrise, one-hundred-and-nine are open, and you're ankle-deep in diamonds. [proud] No alarms, no witnesses. The perfect heist, with one job left: the *trash*. [quick] So you and Speedy drive it to a forest by the *highway*. [panicked] But Speedy panics. Instead of burning it, he flings it all over the *woods*.
